items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, that was one of our Al Jolson's --

ctx.x: And I used to go get my horn sometime, and he'd -- I can still play some passages that he showed me, 'Liza,' you know, 'cause 'Liza' was a pretty rough tune to jam on in those days.
Yeah, that was one of our Al Jolson's --
It had a lot of changes. That's right, it had a lot of changes in it, and Teddy showed me a couple of runs in there, which is still as beautiful today.
